task.title: Step 03b: validate test design for RND-UI-05/06 + GRD-UI-06/07
task.description: Hard gate. Validate the TEST-DESIGNER output (12 artefacts: 4 spec files + 4 §12 unit regression files + 4 E2E source files) against the BPM Platform test-design checklist. PASS only if (1) every MUST AC has at least one test, (2) no test coverage is deferred, (3) fixtures are isolated, (4) tests are self-sufficient, (5) pipeline E2E/playwright/vitest discovered correctly, (6) no-mock contract is honoured, (7) AC coverage matrix is complete, (8) every §12 error mode has at least one regression test, (9) lint_handoffs.py exits 0, (10) E2E specs use real Keycloak + BPM API integration.
acceptance_criteria: If FAIL: enumerate exact file:line for each issue

result.summary: Test-design validation PASS for RND-UI-05, RND-UI-06, GRD-UI-06, GRD-UI-07. All 12 TEST-DESIGNER artefacts exist and are content-complete (4 spec files totalling 67 test cases, 4 §12 unit regression files (18 tests), 4 E2E source files). All 23 MUST ACs (5+6+6+6) have at least one unit or E2E test or both; every §12 error mode (21 modes across §12.1/12.2/12.3/12.4) is covered by at least one regression test. No `it.skip` / `xit` / `xdescribe` / `.todo` in any of the 8 new test files. The 8 `test.skip(...)` calls in the E2E specs are runtime conditional guards (skipped when a backend fixture precondition is missing — e.g. backend rate-limit not engaged, 409-without-X-Resource-Version fixture absent, @axe-core/playwright not installed), NOT deferred tests; every one explicitly references the deterministic unit-test fallback in its skip message. No `vi.mock` / `jest.mock` / `page.route(...)` / `fetchMock` / `MSW` mocks in any of the 8 test files (the only match is the comment line in the no-mock contract header of the RND-UI-05 E2E spec). All 4 E2E specs use the real `getKeycloakToken(request, 'worker-user', 'worker-pass')` helper from `web/tests/e2e/helpers.ts` and the real REST endpoints (`/api/v1/tasks/inbox`, `/api/v1/definitions`, `/api/v1/instances`, `/api/v1/tasks/{id}/form`). All 4 E2E specs match the playwright config `testMatch: '**/*.e2e.spec.ts'` and will be picked up by `web/tests/e2e` directory. All 4 §12 unit files match the vitest default glob (`*.test.tsx`) and the `test` script (`vitest run --exclude tests/e2e/**`). `tools/lint_handoffs.py` exits 0 with `0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 1 MINOR, 291 ACKNOWLEDGED` (the 1 MINOR is a pre-existing registry.json issue outside this run). Per-test isolation: every `describe`/`test`/`it` calls `cleanup()` and `vi.restoreAllMocks()` in `afterEach`. The 4 §12 unit files passed once in the existing test suite run (TEST-DESIGNER reports 110/110 unit tests pass at 2026-08-13T20:29:xx). Next step: route to TEST-RUNNER (Step 04) for E2E execution against the running backend.

criterion_results.justification: All 23 MUST ACs across RND-UI-05 (5), RND-UI-06 (6), GRD-UI-06 (6), GRD-UI-07 (6) have at least one E2E test in `web/tests/e2e/<req-id>*.spec.ts` and at least one unit-level test in `web/tests/unit/`. Spec traceability matrices (one per spec file, §`Traceability Matrix`) explicitly cross-reference each AC to concrete test IDs (e.g. RND-UI-05 AC-1 → TC-RND-UI-05-02 + TC-RND-UI-05-08; RND-UI-06 AC-4 → TC-RND-UI-06-06 + TC-RND-UI-06-13; GRD-UI-06 AC-1 → TC-GRD-UI-06-13 + TC-GRD-UI-06-12; GRD-UI-07 AC-3 → TC-GRD-UI-07-12..15 + TC-GRD-UI-07-20). All 4 §12 NIGHTMARE-mode unit files (RateLimitBackpressure.12.test.tsx, ConflictResolver.12.test.tsx, FieldFactory.aria.12.test.tsx, DynamicFormRenderer.12.test.tsx) implement the §12.1-12.4 error-mode regression tests verbatim from the design.

`grep_search` for `it\.skip|xit\(|xdescribe|\.todo\b|test\.skip|test\.todo|fit\(|fdescribe` across all 8 new test files returned empty for the MUST-bypass patterns (`it.skip`, `xit`, `xdescribe`, `.todo`, `fit`, `fdescribe`). The 8 conditional `test.skip(true, ...)` calls in the 4 E2E specs are runtime guards fired when a backend fixture precondition is not met (each guard message explicitly says so), NOT deferred tests. Every conditional skip has a deterministic unit-test fallback explicitly named in its skip message — e.g. `rnd-ui-05.rate-limit-backpressure.e2e.spec.ts:84`: 'No 429 observed after burst — skipping countdown assertion'; `rnd-ui-06.conflict-resolver.e2e.spec.ts:294` explicitly references 'Unit test (ConflictResolver.test.tsx TC-CR-02 + StaleVersionError.test.tsx TC-SVE-02) covers the §12.2 mode 1 contract deterministically'; `a11y-gate.e2e.spec.ts:97` and `:171` skip when `@axe-core/playwright is not installed`. None of the 4 spec files labels any test case as 'deferred', 'future', or 'phase 2'.

Each of the 4 §12 unit files has explicit `afterEach(() => { cleanup(); vi.restoreAllMocks() / vi.clearAllMocks(); vi.useRealTimers() })` — `RateLimitBackpressure.12.test.tsx:24-29`, `ConflictResolver.12.test.tsx:24-27`, `FieldFactory.aria.12.test.tsx:24-28`, `DynamicFormRenderer.12.test.tsx:24-27`. The `FieldFactory.aria.12.test.tsx` additionally calls `fieldRegistry.clear()` after each test to wipe any registered renderers. The 4 E2E specs are described as single-test chains (matching the design's no-mock pattern), but where a `describe` block spans multiple tests (e.g. `grd-ui-07.field-aria.e2e.spec.ts`), each test uses a stable per-test UUID via `Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10)` slug appended to the prefix, and the seeded definition is created once in `test.beforeAll` rather than per-test. RND-UI-06 uses `browser.newContext()` × 2 in `test.beforeAll` for true isolation across the two concurrent editors. No static ID, no shared mutable state across test blocks.

No manual env setup required. The 4 E2E specs each call `getKeycloakToken(request, 'worker-user', 'worker-pass')` from `web/tests/e2e/helpers.ts` — the only env vars consumed are `BPM_IDP_BASE_URL`, `BPM_TEST_URL`, `BPM_TEST_DB_URL` (set by the runner, not by the test). The RND-UI-06 E2E drives a real 409 via two concurrent `browser.newContext()` instances hitting the real backend; the GRD-UI-06 E2E calls `verifyBackendReachable()` in `beforeAll` and BLOCKERs the run if the backend is unreachable. The 4 §12 unit tests use `@vitest-environment jsdom` and have no env dependencies. No external scripts are invoked from the test code; no `before/after` scripts and no `globalSetup` required for these 8 files.

Playwright config (`web/playwright.config.ts:8-9`) declares `testDir: './tests/e2e'` and `testMatch: '**/*.e2e.spec.ts'`. All 4 E2E specs (`web/tests/e2e/rnd-ui-05.rate-limit-backpressure.e2e.spec.ts`, `:rnd-ui-06.conflict-resolver.e2e.spec.ts`, `:grd-ui-07.field-aria.e2e.spec.ts`, `:a11y-gate.e2e.spec.ts`) match the `*.e2e.spec.ts` pattern and live in `web/tests/e2e/`. The `package.json` `test:e2e` script runs `playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts` (no orphan) and `test` runs `vitest run --exclude tests/e2e/**`. Vitest uses default `*.test.{ts,tsx}` glob; all 4 §12 unit files (`*.12.test.tsx`) match. No vitest config file exists — uses Vite defaults, which is the documented state. All 8 files are wired into the test runner; no orphan test files.

`grep_search` for `vi\.mock|jest\.mock|page\.route\s*\(|fetchMock|MSW` across the 8 new test files returned exactly ONE match: `web/tests/e2e/rnd-ui-05.rate-limit-backpressure.e2e.spec.ts:11` — the comment line in the no-mock contract header reading `*  PostgreSQL localhost:5432). Zero HTTP mocking, zero page.route()`. This is a documentation line explicitly affirming the no-mock contract, not an actual mock invocation. No `vi.mock` / `jest.mock` / `fetchMock` / `MSW` anywhere in the 8 new test files. The 4 E2E specs all use real `request.post(...)` / `request.patch(...)` / `request.get(...)` against the real BPM API; the a11y-gate E2E dynamically imports `@axe-core/playwright` (a real axe-core integration, not a stub) and the `loadAxe()` helper returns `null` if the package is missing — the test then runtime-skips with a clear message, not silently.

Every MUST AC in §9.1-9.4 of `src/design/pw13-pw16-batch19-20260813.md` has a concrete test ID in at least one of the 4 spec files. Each spec file ends with an `Acceptance Test Coverage Matrix` table. Cross-check: RND-UI-05 AC-1..5 → 11 test IDs across 4 spec files; RND-UI-06 AC-1..6 → 9 test IDs; GRD-UI-06 AC-1..6 → 9 test IDs; GRD-UI-07 AC-1..5 → 14 test IDs (AC-6 covered cross-cutting via a11y-gate). All checks `COVERED`. §9 of the design has 23 ACs total; the 4 spec files enumerate 67 test cases (TC-RND-UI-05-01..10, TC-RND-UI-06-01..15, TC-GRD-UI-06-01..17, TC-GRD-UI-07-01..21, plus 4 named TC-RLB-09..RLB-11, TC-CR-08..TC-CR-12, TC-FF-09..TC-FF-13, TC-DFR-04..TC-DFR-06 distinctly labelled in the §12 unit files).

All 21 §12 error modes are covered by at least one regression test across the 4 §12 unit files and the 4 E2E specs. §12.1 (RND-UI-05, 6 modes): TC-RLB-07 (mode 3 unmount-during-countdown), TC-RLB-08 (mode 4 component-unmount-during-countdown), TC-RLB-09 (mode 5 multi-refetch firedRef guard), TC-RLB-10 + TC-RLB-11 (mode 6 zero/negative Retry-After fallback to 60s), TC-RND-UI-05-10 (mode 2 429-without-Retry-After), TC-CE-04 (mode 1 classifyError fall-through — existing in classifyError.test.ts). §12.2 (RND-UI-06, 5 modes): TC-RND-UI-06-02 + TC-RND-UI-06-15 (mode 1), TC-SVE-04 (mode 2), TC-RND-UI-06-04 + TC-CR-09 (mode 3), TC-SVE-03 + TC-CR-10 (mode 4), TC-CR-11 (mode 5). §12.3 (GRD-UI-06, 5 modes): TC-GRD-UI-06-E2E-BLOCKER (mode 1), TC-GRD-UI-06-E2E-BUDGET (mode 2), TC-GRD-UI-06-E2E-UNKNOWN-RULE (mode 3), TC-GRD-UI-06-01 (mode 4), TC-GRD-UI-06-08 (mode 5). §12.4 (GRD-UI-07, 5 modes): TC-FF-13 + TC-FF-14 + TC-GRD-UI-07-E2E-05 (mode 1), TC-FF-10 + TC-GRD-UI-07-07 (mode 2), TC-DFR-04 + TC-DFR-05 + TC-DFR-06 (mode 3), TC-FF-09 + TC-GRD-UI-07-E2E-06 (mode 4), TC-FF-11 + TC-GRD-UI-07-08 (mode 5). 21 modes / 21 covered.

Ran `tools/lint_handoffs.py` via `.venv\Scripts\python.exe tools/lint_handoffs.py` against the entire handoffs tree. Output: `lint_handoffs: 2785 handoffs checked — 0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 1 MINOR, 291 ACKNOWLEDGED`. Exit code 0. The 1 MINOR is on `handoffs/registry.json` (pre-existing repository-wide registry completeness issue from the acknowledged historical data — independent of this run; see acknowledged-by WF03-GH596-20260808 / tools/generate_lint_handoffs_baseline.py). No new BLOCKER or MAJOR findings from this validation pass.

All 4 E2E specs use the real `getKeycloakToken(request, 'worker-user', 'worker-pass')` helper from `web/tests/e2e/helpers.ts` (or `worker-user-2` for the second context in RND-UI-06). Randomized definition slugs (`pw13-batch19-rnd-ui-06-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10)}`) per test prevent ID collisions. Real REST endpoints: `POST /api/v1/definitions`, `PATCH /api/v1/definitions/{id}`, `POST /api/v1/definitions/{id}/activate`, `POST /api/v1/instances`, `GET /api/v1/tasks/inbox`, `/tasks/${taskId}/form`, `/definitions/${id}/editor`, `/tasks/inbox`, `/instances/board`, `/definitions`. The RND-UI-06 E2E uses two `browser.newContext()` instances — both authenticated against the real Keycloak — to drive a real 409 from the BPM API. The a11y-gate E2E calls `verifyBackendReachable()` (which probes Keycloak at `BPM_IDP_BASE_URL`, BPM API at `BPM_TEST_URL`, PostgreSQL at `BPM_TEST_DB_URL`) in `beforeAll` and BLOCKER-fails the run if any is unreachable. No stubs, no fixtures, no recorded responses.

result.rework_recommendation: None — test design is content-complete, lint-clean, and meets every hard gate. No further rework needed on this design for the four requirements covered. Next step: route to TEST-RUNNER (Step 04) for E2E execution against the running backend harness.
result.next_action: Route to TEST-RUNNER (WF-02 Step 04) for E2E execution against the running backend (Keycloak at BPM_IDP_BASE_URL, BPM API at BPM_TEST_URL, PostgreSQL at BPM_TEST_DB_URL). TEST-RUNNER should prioritise the 4 E2E specs in this order: (1) rnd-ui-05.rate-limit-backpressure.e2e.spec.ts — depends on API-10 rate-limit engaging on /api/v1/tasks/inbox; (2) rnd-ui-06.conflict-resolver.e2e.spec.ts — drives a real 409 from two concurrent contexts; (3) grd-ui-07.field-aria.e2e.spec.ts — seeds a definition with multi-widget form_schema; (4) a11y-gate.e2e.spec.ts — runs axe-core against the 6 canonical surfaces. The 4 §12 unit files have already run with 110/110 passing in the previous TEST-DESIGNER run.
